test_title: PYST 35: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

'A × B' means 'A is the sister of B',

'A # B' means 'A is the mother of B',

'A $ B' means 'A is the father of B'.

Based on the above, how is X related to R if X # P $ Q × R?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 ×
 #
 $
 
 

 Meaning
 Sister
 Mother
 Father
 
 

 

Given: X # P $ Q × R

It means: X is the Mother of P, P is the Father of Q, Q is the Sister of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c55a523cd537bbc0cfedf2c75f988e95cc6729e875d6f08f45f1f001fdf729f.png] 

So, X is the '**Father's mother**' of R.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
